plan.primary_bottleneck: Every new transaction scans the entire history list one-by-one to check for duplicates.
hidden_invariants: Duplicate transactions are safely ignored so only the first one counts.
Reversals subtract the full amount with zero processing fee or tax.
UPI payments up to INR 2,000 have zero processing fee.
Payments of INR 50,000 or more are flagged for RBI compliance.
GST is 18% of the fee, rounded half-up to the nearest paisa.
plan.modernization_strategy: Replace the slow list scan with an instant hash-set lookup and modular settlement rules verified against an exact parity digest.
plan.target_gcp_runtime: Cloud Run Jobs with Cloud Spanner
